Filters: evaluation_cohort=location_holdout; status=available; model_id in B1,B2; references=future_chla_operational_proxy plus Carlson tsi_tp_h,tsi_sd_h,tsi_non_chla_h,tsi_all_h; cells are means over five published seed slots and intensity is scaled within each metric
svg.text: F05 - B1/B2 ordinal heatmap: Chl-a proxy and Carlson
Values are five-slot means; color is relative within each metric column, not an inferential signal.
NLA is retained only as a semantic/provenance sentinel; it does not validate monthly WQP targets.
